# contributing

we welcome contributions to the winuz kernel.

you might not fully understand the codebase, but that's okay!

i am volunteering to fix your code, but only if i want to. if your code is okay, i'll help.

rules:
1. use allman style
2. unconventional

you are also allowed to write your own code, but remember the rules.

you can also give me **advice or suggestions** without any code. i highly appreciate it.

you are **allowed to use casual language** as long as it is informative and i can read it.

if your contribution patches a bug, vulnerability, or failure things, you are highly recommended (not required) to create a report inside the "bugs/" directory.
the report must be in rst format following [template.rst](../bugs/template.rst).

hope you all the best!
